channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Are the UK, France being pulled into the Saudi-Houthi conflict?
item.description: The European states say their support for Riyadh is 'defensive', but analysts warn Houthi reaction may complicate that.

item.title: Iran’s enriched uranium re-emerges as point of contention in US talks
item.description: Iran's nuclear enrichment has emerged as a major point of contention amid diplomatic push to end the war.

item.title: WW1 to Houthis: British jets for Saudi Arabia build on long military bond
item.description: UK's deployment of jets to defend Saudi Arabia is the latest chapter in a relationship older than the kingdom itself.

item.title: Blast heard in Yemen’s Aden as Houthis claim attack on military camp
item.description: Smoke seen rising near airport in Aden as Houthis say they attacked a military camp with a ballistic missile.

item.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
item.description: Brian Stack was crossing a street in Dublin in 1983 when he was shot in the back of the neck and died 18 months later.

item.title: Swimmer, 65, killed in shark attack off South Africa's east coast
item.description: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was out on her daily morning swim with her club when she was attacked, her family tell the BBC.

item.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 73 security recruits, local authorities say
item.description: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province on Monday that was being used as a training centre, Yemen's army says.
